props.title: What Is Professional Waxing?
props.text: Waxing Treatment is a professional hair removal method that removes hair from the root, leaving skin smoother for longer than shaving. Our therapists use quality wax products and hygienic techniques to treat different areas, including arms, legs, and sensitive areas such as Brazilian waxing, with care and comfort in mind.

props.title: Our Waxing Options
props.text: Every area of the body has different needs, which is why Spa Bali Moon provides various waxing options for both everyday grooming and special occasions. Each service is performed carefully to help you achieve smooth and well-maintained skin.

props.title: Smooth Skin for Your Bali Holiday
props.text: We offer a practical way to manage unwanted hair while keeping the skin looking neat and well cared for. With different treatment options available, you can choose waxing based on your preferred level of hair removal, the area being treated, and your personal routine. props.title: Areas We Wax

props.title: How Waxing Works
props.text: A Waxing Treatment follows a straightforward process, with each stage carried out according to the area being treated and your skin's comfort. Our therapist prepares the skin, applies the appropriate waxing method, and finishes the session with simple care instructions. The process typically involves:
featuresLeft: Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax for delicate areas
Olive oil strip wax for larger body sections

items.question: How long does waxing results usually last?
items.answer: Waxing results can last several weeks, depending on your natural hair growth cycle, because waxing removes hair from the root and keeps skin smoother for longer than shaving. With regular sessions, many guests notice hair grows back softer and finer over time. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, prices start at IDR 99.000 for under arms.

items.question: Is waxing painful?
items.answer: Waxing may feel slightly uncomfortable, especially during the first session, but professional techniques and suitable wax products help make it more comfortable. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, we use Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax for delicate areas and olive oil strip wax for larger areas, adjust technique to your skin sensitivity and check your comfort throughout.

items.question: Should I shave before my waxing appointment?
items.answer: No. You do not need to shave before waxing at Spa Bali Moon. Hair should be long enough for the wax to grip properly, usually around 1/4 inch. Your therapist prepares the skin before waxing and gives aftercare guidance afterwards. Waxing is available at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel; book on WhatsApp.

items.question: Can I get Brazilian waxing at Spa Bali Moon?
items.answer: Yes. Brazilian waxing at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 350.000 and is done in a private treatment setting with careful techniques to maintain comfort and discretion. For delicate areas we use Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax, and your therapist checks your comfort throughout. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, daily 9am to 11pm.

items.question: What should I avoid after waxing?
items.answer: After waxing, avoid hot showers, intense sun exposure and strong exfoliation for a short period so the skin can remain calm. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, your therapist finishes every waxing treatment with simple aftercare instructions. If you are waxing before a beach day in Bali, keep the sun-exposure advice in mind and follow those instructions.

items.question: Is waxing suitable for men?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak provides waxing options for men, including areas such as the back and Manzilian, with techniques adjusted for comfort and skin sensitivity. Back waxing is from IDR 139.000 and full back is IDR 299.000. Treatments take place in a private setting at our spa, or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I have waxing done at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with everything waxing needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book waxing for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your waxing on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
